payload.reason: The evidence provides clear methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation, detailing both section title embedding and classified section title embedding.

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embedding (STE) by summing the last hidden states of tokenized section titles, leading to similar embeddings for similar titles.
Classified section title embedding (classified STE) replaces intraclass STEs with a predefined class embedding when applicable, otherwise using the original STE.
The hierarchical position of sentences is represented as a vector, indicating relationships between sentences and their section titles, which are crucial in long documents.
